TD Studios luxury website: Next.js 15.5.4 App Router, TypeScript strict, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS 3.4.17, Radix/shadcn New York (RSC), pnpm 10.15.1, Geist, Lucide, Vercel Analytics, Vitest and Playwright. Synced v0.app → GitHub → Vercel.

Structure: `app/` routes, `components/` shared UI, `lib/` utilities/business logic, `public/` assets, `styles/`, `tests/`. Main routes: `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. APIs: `/api/contact` (Resend), `/api/chatkit/session` (OpenAI), `/api/intake` (Supabase). See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md); architecture reference: `docs/architecture-map.json`.

Design: dark luxury, mobile-first, glassmorphism, OKLCH tokens, Geist, responsive StickyHeader, FrostedButton, theme support. Analytics and A/B testing track interactions and conversions. SEO includes canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter Card, JSON-LD.

Environment (`.env.local`; template `.env.local.example`): `RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME`, `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE`.

Commands:
pnpm dev
pnpm serve
pnpm build
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm ci:verify
pnpm report:types
pnpm scan:secrets
pnpm scan:secrets:staged
pnpm test
pnpm test:watch
pnpm test:jest
npx playwright test
npx playwright test --ui
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts
pnpm lh:routes

Vitest uses `vitest.config.ts`, `tests/setup.ts`, `*.spec.ts?(x)`; excludes Playwright tests. Playwright covers responsive/mobile behavior; screenshots at `tests/screenshots/`. Build ignores ESLint and TypeScript errors for deployment compatibility. Images: `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; www redirects permanently (301) to root domain.

JWT client portals use `jose`, `JWT_SECRET`, and client passcodes. Use strict typing, `@/*` imports, `"use client"` for interactive components, accessible semantic HTML/ARIA/keyboard support, mobile-first Tailwind, and analytics. v0.app sync may affect manual edits; use v0.app for major changes.

Husky hooks: pre-commit scans staged files for secrets; pre-push blocks direct pushes to main and scans secrets. Direct pushes to main are blocked; use feature branch + PR. Run `pnpm ci:verify` before commits. Secret scanning uses secretlint.
